issues.issue: Flag on number '024' is a false positive; the citation says 'study 24' and the design/n citations reference 'Study 024', so the trial name is adequately supported (cosmetic numbering variant).

Tremor figures '15 (3 g) vs 8 placebo' are not clearly supported; the only tremor citation is 'Tremor 20 (15) 7 (16) 11 (8)' which does not map cleanly to a '3 g vs placebo' comparison, making the number '8 placebo' and '15' uncited/mislabeled.

The '28%' fatigue SABRIL figure is cited but the placebo fatigue rate '15%' in the text is supported; however the fatigue SABRIL N denominator and the tremor parenthetical remain the automated-flag concern — the '3' flag is a false positive (it refers to '3 g' dose), so dismissable.

The result labels the 8.5→5.5 and 9.0→7.0 values as 'CPS frequency' but the study endpoint/citation concerns 'all partial seizures'; the table quotes do not state these are CPS-specific medians, so the 'CPS' labeling overstates the citation.

P<0.05 is asserted for Study 024, but the cited table/footnote applies the asterisk to Study 025 arms (line 41/42); Study 024's 3 g value '5.5' has no asterisk in its quote (line 38), so the P<0.05 significance claim for Study 024 is unsupported and likely wrong (Study 024 is generally the equivocal trial).
States '1 g/day (N=45) was not effective' — supported by the cited 7.5→7.7 values showing no reduction, acceptable.
priority_review present=false is plausible but the long multi-cycle history and no explicit review-designation statement leaves this unverifiable; not a confirmed defect.

Summary lists SHARE as part of REMS/post-marketing and describes 'post-marketing requirements covering pediatric study and vision-loss safety' but includes details (SHARE distribution) whose numeric/program linkage spans multiple cited quotes; the claim is broadly supported but stitches REMS and PMR content beyond any single citation.

value=false is correctly supported here because the review explicitly documents prior Not Approvable Letters (1995, 1998) and an Approvable Letter (1997); consistent with crl_history.prior_crl=true — no defect.

Date field cites 'Not-Approvable letter issued in March, 1995' but the date field elsewhere states 'April 28, 1995'; the basis citation says 'March, 1995' while the rest of the card uses April 28, 1995, creating an internal date inconsistency.
